evidence.trigger: The coordinator Kernel store's latest run for task X is a stopped run from an earlier attempt before the batch. Lane-mode child X is 'enrolled' with lane.run_id=run-s2, and its Lane store (child.lane.path) holds the active claim for X, or its Lane store is missing or unreadable. Inside laneChildLifecycleOf, readActiveClaimTaskId(lane.path) === X, or the try block throws, so control falls through to kernelLifecycleOf(root, X). That reads the coordinator's latest run row (readSettledRunEvidence -> readRunRowByTask) and returns 'stopped'. inFlightChildOf then returns null, and retireStaleBatch supersedes the batch while X is still running in its Lane. AC3 requires stale_batch_in_flight here. The same fall-through applies when the Lane store's terminal run is not the enrolled run_id. The new test seeds no coordinator run for the stuck child, so this case is never exercised. Fix: once child.lane is bound, return null when the Lane store has an active claim for the child, holds a run other than the enrolled one, or cannot be read. Only consult the coordinator store when the Lane store holds no run for the task at all. Add a test that seeds a terminal coordinator run next to an active, mismatched or missing Lane store and asserts rejection.

evidence.trigger: Setup: ~/.claude/commands/drive.md (or .claude/commands/drive.md, or Pi .pi/prompts/drive.md) exists but is empty, larger than MAX_ALIAS_BYTES (64 KiB), not a regular file, or unreadable (EACCES). readAliasFile returns null or an empty string for all of these. recognizePhaseEntry checks `if (body)`, which is false, and falls through to packaged('drive') with no local skill. Result: the Host runs the user's own drive command, but the hook records a run entry and mints the entry token (a probe of the review-commit phase_entry.ts returned 'run' for both alias:()=>'' and alias:()=>null). That token admits enroll, start_unattended_batch and retire_stale_batch without a real drive entry. Fix: the alias port should tell a clean ENOENT apart from present-but-unreadable or empty, and the bare form should mint nothing in the second case, the same way localSkillExists fails closed. Add a test that pins an empty and an oversized same-named drive.md with no token minted.

acceptance_text: Per #318 Decisions and G-D2 (docs/specs/skill-rename-bare-verbs.spec.md D2): the run-entry gate recognizes only the new names, through the Host input hooks on both Hosts. Positive: /drive, /immune-brain:drive, /skill:drive, /clarify, /draw-up and an alias whose body contains /drive enter their phase and a run entry mints a token. Negative: /imm-run, /imm-loop, alias bodies naming imm-run or imm-loop, an alias body 'drive the build', /driver, an alias body with two distinct marked phase mentions, a same-named user or project skill for bare /drive (Claude Code and Pi) and for /skill:drive on Pi, and a throwing skill reader all enter nothing and mint no token. Bound: a same-named user command is parsed by alias rules, and /immune-brain:drive still mints on Claude Code when a same-named user skill exists. Agreed seams: tests/phase-entry.test.ts, tests/claude-phase-entry-gate.test.ts, tests/claude-phase-entry-skill-gate.test.ts, tests/pi-phase-entry-gate.test.ts.
